items.label: MA-AG civil: Barnhardt Manufacturing Company
items.detail: Settlement with the Attorney General of allegations that a sulfuric acid spill from the Colrain bleaching plant killed more than 270000 fish in the North River; date is the announcement date. Amount is the AG part only: up to $500000 in penalties (including $200000 to the Natural Heritage and Endangered Species Fund) plus $300000 to fund culvert work plus more than $360000 for restoration and assessment costs (stated floor); the separate EPA administrative settlement of about $305000 is not counted; release says nothing on admission.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: Barnhardt "will also pay up to $500,000 in penalties". The release does not say how much of that is firm, so the row counts the full $500,000 within its $1.16 million. This may overstate the cash; it is listed so that is visible.
